patthana21.27:1.1: paritto dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na na hetuṃ na parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu paritto dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, (gaṇitakena tīṇi.)
patthana21.27:2.1: na hetuṃ na mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.27:3.1: na hetuṃ na appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, hetuyā tīṇi, na hetuṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ
